mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , t1.TR_YMD AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD AS tr_cd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , t1.TASA_JM_CD AS tasa_jm_cd , sc.FUND_NM AS xx_tasa_jm_cd , sc.FUND_NM AS tasa_fund_nm , t1.SEQ_NO AS seq_no , t1.TR_JWA AS tr_jwa , t1.GIJUNGA AS gijunga , t1.GGIJUNGA AS ggijunga , t1.TR_AEK AS tr_aek , t1.GTR_JWA AS gtr_jwa , t1.TR_CO_CD AS tr_co_cd , t1.GIJUNGA_YMD AS gijunga_ymd , t1.SUDO_YMD AS sudo_ymd , F_TR_CO_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.TR_CO_CD) AS xx_tr_co_cd , F_TR_CO_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.TR_CO_CD) AS tr_co_nm , t1.UPD_JWA AS upd_jwa , t1.SUSU AS susu , t1.ORG_TR_YMD AS org_tr_ymd , t1.ORG_SEQ_NO AS org_seq_no , t1.TASA_SEOLJ_YMD AS tasa_seolj_ymd , NVL(sc.TRANS_UNIT, 1000) AS trans_unit , 1 AS p_visible FROM SJT5SG t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD JOIN SJM0SC sc ON sc.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND sc.TASA_JM_CD = t1.TASA_JM_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY t1.TR_YMD ASC , t1.TR_CD ASC , t1.TR_CO_CD ASC , t1.FUND_CD ASC , t1.TASA_JM_CD ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd FROM SJT5SG t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD IN ( SELECT ta.TR_CD FROM SZX1PT ta WHERE ta.OBJ_ID = 'W_JA031D' ) ORDER BY tr_ymd
SELECT t1.MG_CD AS "mgCd" , t2.TR_CO_NM AS "trCoNm" FROM SZM0IA t1 JOIN SZX2MM t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.TR_CO_CD = t1.MG_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd}

SELECT NVL(s.DANG_GIJUN_GA, NVL(p.GIJUN_GA, 1000)) AS "gijunga" , NVL(s.DANG_GGIJUN_GA, NVL(p.GGIJUN_GA, 1000)) AS "ggijunga" FROM (SELECT #{corpGr} AS corp_gr, #{ymd} AS ymd FROM DUAL) d LEFT OUTER JOIN SJT0SC s ON s.CORP_GR = d.corp_gr AND s.YMD = d.ymd AND s.JM_CD = #{jmCd} LEFT OUTER JOIN PZM1TI p ON p.YMD = d.ymd AND p.TASA_FUND_CD = #{tasaFundCd} WHERE ROWNUM = 1
